name: bunest-nestjs-comparison-benchmark
description: Standalone isolated head-to-head benchmark comparing Bunest vs real upstream NestJS (Fastify & Express) on Bun and Node.js

scripts.build:node: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && bun -e "await Bun.write('dist/package.json', JSON.stringify({ type: 'commonjs' }, null, 2) + '\n')"
scripts.bench: bun run build:node && bun run src/runner.ts
scripts.bench:quick: bun run build:node && bun run src/runner.ts --quick
scripts.verify: bun run build:node && bun run src/runner.ts --verify-only
